sentences.text: S1 (Amina Hussain, health visitor) stated she is conducting Leo's two-year review and will check on Poppy.
S2 (Jade Turner, mother) stated she forgot the health visitor was coming.
S2 (Jade Turner) stated Leo is saying 'quite a few' words, specifically listing: 'Mama', 'car', 'more', 'bye-bye', 'dog', and estimated 'Maybe twenty'.
S2 (Jade Turner) stated Leo sometimes puts two words together, specifically 'more juice'.
S2 (Jade Turner) stated Leo is running and climbing, noting he 'climbed the bookcase last week'.
S2 (Jade Turner) stated Leo is fussy about eating, listing: 'Toast', 'pasta', 'yoghurt'.
S2 (Jade Turner) stated Poppy is fed via bottles, about six times a day, and has been started on baby rice.
S1 (Amina Hussain) observed Poppy has 'quite a bad nappy rash here' which is 'broken in places'.
S2 (Jade Turner) disclosed she ran out of nappies on Sunday and has been 'leaving them on longer'.
S2 (Jade Turner) stated the nappy rash has been present for 'About a week'.
S2 (Jade Turner) disclosed she has 'left them on their own' when Shannon cannot look after them.
S2 (Jade Turner) stated the children are left alone 'Only for a couple of hours' and 'they're asleep. They don't even wake up'.
S2 (Jade Turner) stated this occurs 'Three nights a week, maybe' and 'Since Shannon got her new job. So, the last month'.
S2 (Jade Turner) stated she is scared she will be 'evicted' if she loses her job because she 'can't pay the rent without it'.
S2 (Jade Turner) stated she has had 'No, nothing like [letters from the landlord] or any notice' and the rent is 'paid up', but she 'just worry[es] it won't be'.
S2 (Jade Turner) stated she has managed for food with 'bread and some cereal' and 'one tin [of milk] left' for Poppy, noting 'That's it till Friday'.
S1 (Amina Hussain) confirmed the food supply lasts 'Till Friday, when your money comes in'.
S2 (Jade Turner) stated she receives 'Universal credit' and described her financial situation as 'tight'.
S2 (Jade Turner) stated she started a cleaning job at a retail park in September, working nights, which is 'cash in hand basically'.
S2 (Jade Turner) stated the night shift hours are 'Ten till twelve, sometimes half twelve'.
S2 (Jade Turner) stated her friend Shannon usually looks after Leo and Poppy, but 'she can't always'.
S2 (Jade Turner) stated her mum is in Northby and 'would help', but 'we're not really talking'.
S2 (Jade Turner) stated she did not know about Leo's eligibility for 'fifteen hours funded nursery'.
S1 (Amina Hussain) stated 'Little Acorns on Marlow Road has spaces from January'.
S2 (Jade Turner) stated she will 'text my supervisor' to say she has 'no childcare'.
S1 (Amina Hussain) stated she will make a referral to children's social care 'today' and 'someone should ring you by Thursday'.
S1 (Amina Hussain) stated she will drop a food bank voucher 'round this afternoon, before three'.
S1 (Amina Hussain) stated she will book Poppy in with Dr Lowe for the nappy rash 'tomorrow' and will bring nappies.
S1 (Amina Hussain) stated she will return on 'Monday the thirtieth at ten' to see how the family is doing and help with the nursery form.
